records.text: But I can say that I have positively verified something about the injury that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) sustained to his neck that I think is going to go a very long way in terms of helping those of us who have been sleuthing, those of us who want answers, those of us who are dedicating our time to this, because what we are being told by the authorities beggars belief, as John and Irina Matlin said. It just simply beggars belief.
